name: Spectator/Broadcast Mode
author: Kizi & RK
description: Beta. After you crash the race keeps going and you watch it with the broadcast camera. Can also park you and your teammate in the garage. Idea: Terminal Damage by nyannoying.

options.label: Watch: start by itself
options.description: Switches to the broadcast camera by itself when your car is out, or while AI Drive is driving. Turn it off if you only want the AI to drive.

options.label: Watch: move to a car that is still racing
options.description: If the camera is on your wreck, or on a car that retires, it moves to a car that is still racing. Races only; never the safety car.

options.label: Watch: automatic camera director
options.description: Switches the camera by itself like a TV director: crashes, overtakes, pit stops, battles, the leaders at the start and on the last lap, then the winner. Races only. Needs the game's UDP telemetry on (see the page).

options.label: Keys: watch on/off key
options.description: Turns the broadcast camera on and off by hand (default F4). It only works while the game window is in front.

options.label: Keys: your camera key
options.description: Pressed once when watching stops, so your own camera comes back. Set it to the key you use to change camera in the game.

options.label: After a crash: keep the race going
options.description: When your car is destroyed the game normally ends your race. On: the race goes on and you watch the rest.

options.label: After a crash: put my wreck in the garage
options.description: The wrecked car is moved into its garage after this many seconds and stays there until a restart. Needs "keep the race going".

options.label: Garage start: park my car before the race
options.description: Your car goes to the garage while you are on the setup and strategy screens, and you watch the whole race. For a spectator team.

options.label: Garage start: park my teammate too
options.description: Also puts your teammate in the garage. Needs "park my car" and the game's UDP telemetry (see the description).

options.label: Window: keep the game running in the background
options.description: The game keeps running and playing sound when you click another window, instead of pausing.

options.label: Look: hide the game logo
options.description: Hides the F1 logo in the corner of the spectator screen. A change applies the next time you press Play.

options.label: Advanced: telemetry port
options.description: The UDP port the game sends its telemetry to (Settings > Telemetry). Only used for "park my teammate too".

options.label: Advanced: pass a copy to another program
options.description: The game sends telemetry to one port only. To use another tool at the same time, set its port to this value.

options.label: Advanced: detailed log
options.description: Extra lines in the log for bug reports. Turn off if the game stutters.
